title: Being shows longitudinal scalar waves as slinkies

tellings.quote: the way, these longitudinal waves were shown to me by this being basically as slinkies so to speak that that exists all around us.

plain: Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics, says that in 2021, at his home, a being showed him what he calls longitudinal or scalar waves, waves that squeeze and stretch along the direction they travel. He tells Michels the being showed them to him "basically as slinkies," and that they exist "all around us." He tells it as something he experienced himself, and to him it is a glimpse of physics that science has not yet worked out.
